registration: E27 physical-time source and original DM14 conditional halo references inspected BEFORE registration; ONLY new E28 finite-band 3D reciprocal-force numerical experiment fixed here. Not a registered galaxy prediction.

frozen_physical_benchmark.halo_mass_cases: Exact E27/E17D2B1 conditional 1e12 and 1e13 h_DM14^-1 Msun physical anchors, alpha=.4/.8
frozen_physical_benchmark.halo_form: Original E17D2B0 DM14 median c200c,r_s physical at z=.95, spherical truncated NFW, shape held fixed in physical size from z=1 to .95; normalization follows original E17D2B1 M_alpha(z). This is an ADDITIONAL uncalibrated history assumption and DM14 CLASS background mixing, not same-object halo.
frozen_physical_benchmark.incoming_wake: Zero at z=1, same original short historical window as E27.
frozen_physical_benchmark.k_quadrature: Composite Simpson in ln(k): 12 vs 24 intervals PER predeclared band, common exact boundaries.
frozen_physical_benchmark.nfw_radial_quadrature: Gauss-Legendre 64 points on y=r/r_s in [0,c], normalized by ln(1+c)-c/(1+c).
frozen_physical_benchmark.angular_integral: Exact integral of i mu exp(i k mu dx) dmu over -1..1 equals 2 sinc_prime(k dx). No artificial LOS-angle sampling.
frozen_physical_benchmark.rho_neutrino: Direct rest-mass density for one massive nu+anti species from original CLASS-normalized 4000q F0/Fplus/Fminus, mnu=.06 eV and Tnu0=.71611*2.7255 K. Newtonian nonrel approximation at z=.95; use SI hbar c, eV, Msun and Mpc constants.
frozen_physical_benchmark.force: Physical halo-averaged acceleration from total neutrino wake potential only, a_parallel=(G*a*rho_nu/PI) integral_{kband} dk k u_h(k)^2 pref_E27(k) integral_z dz [M(z)/M0 * H_F(s)/H_CLASS(z)*2 sinc_prime(k dx(z))], in (km/s)^2/Mpc. Each halo profile factor appears once in source and once in mass-averaged force.
frozen_physical_benchmark.negative_controls: v=0 implies force=0; v reversal flips sign; imaginary density sign and real force consistent; density mass dimension and finite NFW radial normalization; source original pinned and E27 single k closure; no pseudo M200c measurement, no double-counted epsilon Euler term.

acceptance.signed_Fpm_contrast_status: Only claim sign if 12/24 by 129/257 resolution relative difference <1% OF THE SIGNED DIFFERENCE; otherwise report unresolved with exact gap and NEVER change grid posthoc.
acceptance.finite_band_convergence: Report 0.01-0.1, 0.01-1, 0.01-8 separately, NO extrapolation to k=infinity, no numerical total drag inference.
